schema: per-difficulty ordered steps. Each: area_id, min_clvl to enter, target clvl to leave, purpose. Entries are suggestions; the bot must not enter an area below min_clvl and must move on above leave_clvl. All levels tag R unless noted; XP/levels cross-checked against Maxroll V (Normal reach 26 at Act 5; Nightmare enter ~clvl 27-38). Normal area levels (V): Blood Moor 1, Cold Plains 2, Stony 4, Dark Wood 5, Black Marsh 6; NM/Hell Blood Moor 36/67 V; Black Marsh 38/69 V; Worldstone Keep 2 40/65/85 V. Fill alvl from levels.txt MonLvl.
